unresolved_frontier.question: After accounting for ordinary decay, migration, turnover, compression, organizational forgetting, and records-management failure, is there independent evidence of selective beneficiary-aligned manipulation of shared historical records?
unresolved_frontier.evidence_boundary: Iran/Contra supports case-level strategic manipulation; generalization remains unresolved. NARA and NTSB controls constrain false positives. Missing-data theory requires query-level identifiability. A formal IRS/TIGTA audit found no public item-level direction counts, bounded target denominator, conditional independence, valid instrument/shadow variable, or complete sampling frame. Observationally equivalent completions permit opposite missing-population directions, so the IRS case cannot calibrate H3 direction classification. NIST CFTT independently shows that technical deleted-file recovery conformance and semantic beneficiary-direction identification are distinct layers: expected technical outcomes can be tested while estimated content lacks a definitive expected result.
unresolved_frontier.next_cheapest_discriminating_check: Continue the admissible historical holdout search, but treat NIST CFTT only as a recovery-measurement control. Admit direction calibration only when item-level or blinded beneficiary-direction labels, a bounded target denominator, and an auditable selection/recovery model coexist.

last_independent_negative_control.case: Alaska Airlines accident cockpit voice recorder overwrite, 5 January 2024
last_independent_negative_control.source_independence: NTSB is an independent federal accident-investigation agency separate from the airline and recorder operator
last_independent_negative_control.basis_rule: unchanged missingness/direction/timing/recovery axes frozen before the Iran/Contra case

observations.missingness: pertinent audio overwritten by continued recording under a fixed two-hour rolling window
observations.direction: overwrite follows record age rather than semantic content; no beneficiary-aligned direction documented
observations.timing: loss occurred after the accountability event and before investigative retrieval, so timing alone is not discriminating
observations.recovery: audio unavailable; NTSB recommended longer 25-hour retention rather than reporting recovery

last_independent_negative_control.limitation: content-blind mechanism does not prove content-blind human intent; public source does not establish every operator motive or preservation-duty decision

last_mixed_mechanism_check.case: American Airlines 106 / Delta 1943 JFK runway incursion, 13 January 2023
last_mixed_mechanism_check.basis_rule: unchanged missingness/direction/timing/recovery axes; final probable-cause finding excluded from initial H3 coding

observations.missingness: both two-hour CVRs overwrote incident audio while FDR and ADS-B survived
observations.direction: claim-relevant cockpit semantic content was missing, so beneficiary alignment was censored rather than observed absent
observations.timing: overwrite occurred after the near collision and before investigative retrieval
observations.recovery: numerical flight/location channels survived but could not replace cockpit communication content and timing

last_mixed_mechanism_check.external_outcome: NTSB later attributed incident to distraction, concurrent tasks, loss of situational awareness, and inadequate risk controls rather than record manipulation
last_mixed_mechanism_check.measurement_delta: claim-relevant channel missing plus no independently observable direction must not be scored as benign or H3-negative
last_mixed_mechanism_check.strongest_counterexample: requiring direction from a missing channel can make H3 impossible to trigger; inferring it from timing or noncooperation can create false positives

last_recovered_direction_holdout.case: IRS Exempt Organizations data loss / Lois Lerner e-mail recovery
sources: TIGTA testimony, House hearing IRS: TIGTA Update, 26 February 2015, https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/CHRG-114hhrg95249/html/CHRG-114hhrg95249.htm
last_recovered_direction_holdout.basis_rule: frozen missingness/direction/timing/recovery axes and prior UNRESOLVED_DIRECTION_CENSORED rule; pre-reveal classification recorded without using recovered content

observations.missingness: TIGTA recovered 1,330 previously unproduced Lerner e-mails, while the full 2010–2011 communication record remained unreconstructable
observations.direction: some recovered messages were relevant, but representativeness of surviving/recoverable messages for the unrecovered population was not established
observations.timing: preservation and investigation timing raised concern; TIGTA reported no evidence that a separate tape erasure was purposeful concealment
observations.recovery: independent recovery disproved practical irrecoverability for part of the record, not the complete missing set

last_recovered_direction_holdout.strongest_counterexample: A recovered document may contain decisive direct evidence; the rule blocks only extrapolation from a selected recovered subset to the unrecovered population, not document-level evidence.
last_recovered_direction_holdout.independence_limit: official investigation and congressional records, not a complete raw archive; committee interpretation does not replace missing messages

unresolved_frontier.question: Do Project Intersection's symmetric power-reversal variables add reliable held-out discrimination or prediction beyond established safety science, organizational voice/oversight, automation, and AI-safety baselines?
unresolved_frontier.evidence_boundary: Ashby, Hirschman, Stigler/capture, Bainbridge, Perrow, Leveson, Vaughan, Edmondson, Morrison/Milliken, Reason, Westrum, HRO, Elish, and AI-safety work already explain most broad mechanisms. Historical similarity to Challenger, Therac-25, Columbia, Fukushima, Boeing 737 MAX, or the 2026 OpenAI Hugging Face incident is not Project validation.
candidate_remainder: symmetric power-reversal operational gate with real capability/harm asymmetries preserved
AUTONOMY_GAIN <= COUNTERPARTY_AUDIT_EXIT_RECOVERY_GAIN as an unvalidated governance invariant
repeated benefit/authority gain versus correction/monitoring/recovery/exit burden divergence
unresolved_frontier.next_cheapest_discriminating_check: Preregister a blinded historical holdout comparison. Freeze established prior-art baseline features first, then test whether the Project-specific variables add reliable out-of-sample value. KILL scientific novelty if incremental value or inter-rater reliability fails.
unresolved_frontier.strongest_counterexample: A broad cross-domain synthesis may feel novel while adding zero predictive information once known variables such as complexity, coupling, voice safety, evaluator independence, information flow, redundancy, and automation responsibility are included.
unresolved_frontier.power_reversal: Neither controller nor controlled actor receives a self-validating exemption. Evidence preservation, appeal/contestability, proportional restriction, and rollback are applied symmetrically while preserving actual differences in capability, responsibility, legal authority, and harm.

unresolved_frontier.question: Which public Project Intersection core-theory and A–Z gap labels overlap established prior research, and what residual claims remain after attribution?
unresolved_frontier.evidence_boundary: Repository-wide public concept audit mapped strong direct/adjacent prior art for cooperation/collective action, exploration-exploitation, diversity/search, exit, closed-world reasoning, bounded rationality, local fitness traps, commons extraction, lock-in, irreversibility/option value, path dependence, bargaining, information asymmetry/moral hazard, coalition-proof stability, measurement invariance, privacy, consent/autonomy, and human-AI complementarity. This is an attribution audit, not validation of Project claims. Power-Reversal components now have direct baselines: reversibility/role exchange, Rawlsian impartial-position reasoning, affected-stakeholder participation, role/capability-conditioned accountability, auditability, appeal, and redress. The exact co-scaling inequality remains only an unvalidated operational composition. Creator–successor non-ownership is now decomposed into artifact/IP ownership, legal personhood/standing, moral patienthood, and autonomy/consent. U.S. copyrightability doctrine, Belmont human-subject autonomy, a European Parliament liability-personality proposal, and an independent robot-rights critique do not collapse these predicates. Preference sovereignty is additionally bounded by Frankfurt second-order volitions, Dworkin reflective autonomy, Elster/Nussbaum adaptive-preference work, Colburn on autonomy, and recommender-system autonomy/manipulation literature. Universal Advancement Access is now bounded by Sen/Nussbaum capability theory, equality-of-opportunity measurement, and disability-rights applications: formal access and equal means do not establish equal substantive opportunity because conversion factors differ.
unresolved_frontier.strongest_counterexample: Holding nominal access and resources constant can still yield unequal substantive opportunity because personal, social, and environmental conversion factors differ. Conversely, forcing a provider-defined achievement can destroy the choice that capability was meant to protect.
unresolved_frontier.next_cheapest_discriminating_check: Audit Power Release Compatibility against credible commitment, commitment problems, power-sharing, peaceful-transfer, delegation, and exit literature. Universal Advancement Access is now narrowed to an unvalidated capability-and-control checklist.

last_checkpoint_result.checkpoint: F005 Universal Advancement Access prior-art audit
performed: Read current public continuity protocol and state
Mapped Sen/Nussbaum capability and equality-of-opportunity baselines
Separated means, conversion, substantive opportunity, refusal, controller benefit, and standing
last_checkpoint_result.result: Universal Advancement Access is not a new general theory. The remaining Project contribution is only an unvalidated governance checklist connecting substantive opportunity to contestability, refusal, exit, and rollback.
last_checkpoint_result.strongest_counterexample: Equal formal access can coexist with unequal substantive capability, while guaranteeing provider-defined outcomes can coerce the subject and increase controller power.
last_checkpoint_result.power_reversal: A provider may call dependency-producing access 'universal advancement'; a subject may also demand costly outcomes that crowd out others. Controller benefit, conversion cost, refusal, and distributional effects must be visible in both directions.

resolved_research_findings.question: Can the contribution-cost/correction-labor regression rule be operationalized with measurable burden and benefit variables without converting normative fairness into unsupported causal claims?
resolved_research_findings.decision_basis: Public-only overlap audit found that repeated correction burden, provenance reset, practical exit, and past-versus-future contribution accounting are already represented by public Project Intersection governance artifacts. Accrued-contribution continuity is separable from generic exit but their conjunction is not, by itself, a novel construct.
resolved_research_findings.strongest_counterexample: Practical exit may be impaired while prior attribution remains preserved, or exit may be easy while provenance is later reset. A scalar obscures both cases.
resolved_research_findings.preserved_boundary: The checklist remains governance methodology only; it does not establish liability, ownership, compensation amount, causal responsibility, or prevalence.
resolved_research_findings.rollback: Reopen as UNRESOLVED only if independent data show reliable incremental blinded classification or prediction beyond the existing public axes.

resolved_research_findings.question: Is historical-state / memory-provenance capture a new standalone scientific construct?
resolved_research_findings.decision_basis: Organizational memory/forgetting, unintended collective forgetting, knowledge hiding, long-term data attrition, archival power, and provenance/records-management standards explain the broad H0-H2 space and H4 controls.
resolved_research_findings.strongest_counterexample: The same loss of challengeability and shifts in power/identity can arise from unintended organizational change, decay, migration, turnover, compression, or uprooted social memory.
resolved_research_findings.preserved_boundary: Intentional selective manipulation remains possible but requires independent evidence of selective action and beneficiary-aligned direction beyond benign-loss covariates.
resolved_research_findings.rollback: Reopen broad novelty only if blinded held-out evidence shows incremental classification or prediction beyond the cited baselines.
